name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: MINISTRY OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING
benefits: Direct capital subsidy of 40% for General category and up to 60% for Women and SC/ST beneficiaries for aquaculture ponds, biofloc units, modern fishing vessels, and cold chain infrastructure
application_process: Apply online via the official portal (https://pmmsy.dof.gov.in/) or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Submit authenticated Aadhaar and requisite KYC documents.
Verification and direct benefit transfer (DBT) credit by departmental officers.
